emptyState.$description: Placeholder for an area whose content is currently absent — first built 2026-07-24 for the Student Message Center prototype ('Choose a Thread' in the reading pane, the type-to-search hint, and the no-results case). Text-only variant for now, deliberately: a box that fills the space its content would normally occupy and centers a single one-line hint. The hint sits on a long, weak, fully-rounded gray pill — Badge's neutral-tint recipe (bg.neutral) stretched under body-size text with radius.full — so it reads as a quiet chip anchored in the space rather than bare text floating in a void. Variants with a heading, illustration, or action button are deferred until a real surface needs them, per the no-speculative-builds rule.

pill.$description: The rounded backdrop under the hint — bg.neutral (the same weak gray tint Badge role=neutral uses) + radius.full. paddingX is deliberately wider than a Badge's so the pill reads 'long' relative to its text, per the driving request.

padding.$description: Breathing room between the pill and the edges of whatever area the empty state is filling, so the pill never touches a border even in a cramped slot.
